components.name: Sidebar Navigation Row
components.description: A compact native component row with a secondary stack icon, one-line name, and monospaced story count.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; padding: 4px 7px; background: SelectedItem; color: SelectedItemText; font: 13px system-ui; text-align: left; } .ds-sidebar-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sidebar-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; opacity: .7; } .ds-sidebar-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sidebar-count { font: 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; opacity: .72; }

components.name: Story Contact-Sheet Row
components.description: A scanable preview-state row pairing a fixed specimen thumbnail with name and layout metadata.
components.css: .ds-story-row { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; padding: 5px 0; background: transparent; color: CanvasText; font-family: system-ui; text-align: left; } .ds-story-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 5%, transparent); } .ds-story-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-story-thumb { width: 92px; height: 62px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: .5px solid ButtonBorder; border-radius: 6px; background: Field; } .ds-story-sample { width: 52px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; background: ButtonFace; border: 1px solid ButtonBorder; } .ds-story-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-story-copy strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-story-copy small { color: GrayText; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Story Thumbnail
components.description: The fixed thumbnail well used for rendered images, loading indicators, and errors.
components.css: .ds-story-thumbnail { width: 92px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: .5px solid ButtonBorder; border-radius: 6px; background: Field; color: FieldText; } .ds-thumbnail-specimen { padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid ButtonBorder; border-radius: 4px; background: Canvas; font: 12px system-ui; }

components.name: Proofing Canvas
components.description: The dominant neutral work field with optional grid and one elevated live specimen.
components.css: .ds-proofing-canvas { min-width: 420px; min-height: 260px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 80px; color-scheme: light dark; background: light-dark(rgb(232 232 232), rgb(33 33 33)); } .ds-live-specimen { padding: 28px 36px; background: Canvas; color: CanvasText; font: 13px system-ui; box-shadow: 0 7px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12); }

components.name: Toolbar Control Group
components.description: Native canvas operations grouped compactly without branded fills or decorative treatment.
components.html: 100%
components.css: .ds-toolbar-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid ButtonBorder; border-radius: 6px; background: ButtonFace; color: ButtonText; font: 13px system-ui; } .ds-toolbar-group button { width: 28px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-toolbar-group button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, ButtonText 8%, transparent); } .ds-toolbar-group button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-toolbar-group output { min-width: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-inline: 1px solid ButtonBorder; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Inspector Section
components.description: A flat metadata section separated by a top hairline and compact labeled values.
components.css: .ds-inspector-section { width: 248px; padding: 16px; border-top: .5px solid ButtonBorder; background: ButtonFace; color: CanvasText; font-family: system-ui; } .ds-inspector-section h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-inspector-section dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 0; font-size: 11px; } .ds-inspector-section dt { color: CanvasText; } .ds-inspector-section dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; color: GrayText; text-align: right; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
Snap Gallery is a quiet macOS workspace for examining live component specimens. Its information architecture is as direct as Storybook—catalog, stories, canvas, metadata—but its materials, density, controls, and behavior belong unmistakably to the Mac. Navigation recedes into system sidebars and lists so the selected component remains the visual hero.

The visual system is restrained and technical: dynamic system neutrals, compact SF typography, hairline structure, and one system-controlled selection accent. The large proofing field supplies the only deliberate stage, while metadata and canvas operations stay close at hand without becoming dashboard chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Native macOS split-view hierarchy rather than a browser-shaped shell.
A component-first proofing canvas with stable framing and generous working space.
System semantic colors and controls that adapt automatically to appearance and accessibility settings.
Dense, aligned navigation and metadata with minimal decoration.
One elevated live specimen; surrounding surfaces remain flat.

rules.name: The System Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Use dynamic macOS semantic colors for interface chrome and selection. Do not freeze those roles into brand hex values.

rules.name: The Canvas Exception Rule
rules.body: Fixed white and black are allowed only when the user deliberately selects them as specimen-testing conditions.

rules.name: The Semantic Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve SwiftUI text styles so the gallery follows macOS typography and accessibility behavior; do not substitute fixed point sizes.

rules.name: The Component Owns the Room Rule
rules.body: Preserve the canvas as the widest region; navigation and metadata columns may clarify the specimen but must not visually outrank it.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevate the live specimen only. Sidebar rows, story rows, inspector sections, and tool controls remain native and flat.

rules.name: The Native Geometry Rule
rules.body: Let macOS controls supply their own corner behavior; add a custom radius only when content clipping requires it.

dos: Do use native split views, lists, inspectors, toolbars, menus, search, empty states, and accessibility semantics.
Do keep the selected component state live, centered, and visually dominant.
Do use semantic system colors and SwiftUI text styles so light, dark, high-contrast, and user-accent settings remain coherent.
Do use hairlines, alignment, and restrained tonal shifts to organize dense engineering information.
Do reserve fixed white, black, checkerboard, and grid treatments for explicit proofing tasks.
donts: Don't turn the catalog into a dashboard of decorative cards.
Don't imitate browser Storybook chrome or introduce web-navigation conventions.
Don't add branded color fills, gradients, ornamental imagery, or display typography to the application chrome.
Don't elevate navigation or metadata surfaces; the live preview is the single lifted object.
Don't expose implementation metadata at the expense of the specimen's working area.
